before.name: neowiki_subject_page
before.comment: Which page holds which Subject. Written with the revision that changes a page's Subjects, so it is never staler than the slot it derives from. Reads join page, so page moves need no maintenance here and rows left by a deleted page resolve to nothing.

columns.name: nwsp_subject_id
columns.comment: Subject id as stored in the subject slot

columns.name: nwsp_page_id
columns.comment: Page holding the Subject. Not a foreign key: a row for a page that no longer exists is inert, since reads join page.

indexes.name: nwsp_page_id
indexes.comment: Index for reading and replacing everything a page holds

after.name: neowiki_subject_page
after.comment: Which page holds which Subject, with the fields needed to name that Subject in a list. Written with the revision that changes a page's Subjects, so it is never staler than the slot it derives from. Reads join page, so page moves need no maintenance here and rows left by a deleted page resolve to nothing.

columns.name: nwsp_subject_id
columns.comment: Subject id as stored in the subject slot

columns.name: nwsp_page_id
columns.comment: Page holding the Subject. Not a foreign key: a row for a page that no longer exists is inert, since reads join page.

columns.name: nwsp_schema
columns.comment: Name of the Schema the Subject follows. Null when the slot names none, which a Subject too broken to deserialize can do.

columns.name: nwsp_label
columns.comment: The Subject's stored label. Null when it has none, which ADR 31 makes the ordinary case.

columns.name: nwsp_is_main
columns.comment: 1 when this Subject is the Main Subject of the page holding it. A page has at most one.

indexes.name: nwsp_page_id
indexes.comment: Index for reading and replacing everything a page holds
